q1.explanationZh: differ 不及物动词“相异；有分歧”，常用 differ from“与……不同”。

q2.explanationZh: difference 是 different 的名词形式“差别；不同”，make a difference“有影响，起作用”。

q3.explanationZh: different 形容词“不同的”，be different from“与……不同”。

q4.explanationZh: difficult 形容词“困难的”，常用 it is difficult to do sth.。

q5.explanationZh: difficult 的名词形式 difficulty“困难”，复数 difficulties。

q6.explanationZh: dig“挖，掘”，过去式和过去分词都是 dug。

q7.explanationZh: digest 作动词“消化；吸收”，作名词“摘要；文摘”，词性不同，重音位置也不同。

q8.explanationZh: digit 名词“数字；数位”，形容词是 digital。

q9.explanationZh: digit 加 -al 构成形容词 digital“数字的”，如 digital camera。

q11.explanationZh: diligent 形容词“勤奋的”，名词是 diligence。

q12.explanationZh: dim 形容词“昏暗的；模糊的”，名词 dimness。

q13.explanationZh: dimension 名词“尺寸；面积；规模”，常用复数 dimensions。

q14.explanationZh: dine 是不及物动词“进正餐”，就餐者是 diner。

q15.explanationZh: 题目要求名词，用 dine 的 -ing 形式 dining，注意去掉 e 再加 -ing。

q16.explanationZh: dinner 名词“正餐”，have dinner“吃饭”，注意双写 n。

q17.explanationZh: dinosaur 名词“恐龙”，注意拼写 -saur。

q18.explanationZh: di- 表示“二”，oxide 是“氧化物”，dioxide“二氧化物”，carbon dioxide“二氧化碳”。

q19.explanationZh: dip 及物动词“浸；蘸”，过去式 dipped（双写 p）。

q20.explanationZh: diploma 名词“毕业文凭”，与 diplomat“外交官”拼写相近，别混淆。

q21.explanationZh: diplomat 名词“外交官”，比 diploma 多一个 t。

q22.explanationZh: direct 可作动词“给……指路；指导”，也可作形容词“直接的”和副词“直接地”。

q23.explanationZh: direct 加 -ion 构成名词 direction“方向”，复数 directions 可表示“说明，指示”。

q24.explanationZh: direct 加 -or 表示人，director“主管；导演”。

q25.explanationZh: directory 名词“人名地址录；目录”，注意以 -ory 结尾。

q26.explanationZh: dirt 名词“污物；灰尘”，形容词是 dirty。

q27.explanationZh: dirt 加 -y 构成形容词 dirty“脏的”。

q28.explanationZh: dis- 表示否定，ability“能力”，disability“无能力；残疾”。

q29.explanationZh: disabled 形容词“有残疾的”，动词 disable“使丧失能力”。

q30.explanationZh: dis- 表示否定，advantage“优势”，disadvantage“不利地位”，可作名词和动词。

q31.explanationZh: dis- + agree + -able，disagreeable“令人不快的”，注意 agree 后直接加 -able。

q32.explanationZh: dis- 表示相反，appear“出现”，disappear“消失”，是不及物动词。

q33.explanationZh: disappoint 及物动词“使失望”，注意一个 s、两个 p。

q34.explanationZh: disappointed 形容词“（人）感到失望的”，be disappointed at/with。

q35.explanationZh: disapprove 去 e 加 -al 构成名词 disapproval“不赞成”。

q36.explanationZh: dis- 表示否定，approve“赞成”，disapprove“不赞成”，常接 of。

q37.explanationZh: disaster 名词“灾难”，natural disaster“自然灾害”，形容词 disastrous。

q38.explanationZh: differ from“与……不同”，from 表示比较的对象。

q40.explanationZh: disagreeable“令人不快的”，a disagreeable experience“令人不愉快的经历”。

accept: the important digests of a book

q41.explanationZh: digest 作名词“摘要”，the important digests of a book“书的重点摘要”。

q42.explanationZh: to the disadvantage of sb.“对某人不利”，disadvantage 是名词。

q43.explanationZh: at a disadvantage“处于不利地位”，注意用介词 at 和冠词 a。

q44.explanationZh: direct to/towards“指向”，to 和 towards 都可以。

q45.explanationZh: under the direction of ...“在……指导下”，介词用 under。

q46.explanationZh: “朝……方向”用 in the direction of，介词用 in，不用 to。

q47.explanationZh: opposite“相反的”，in the opposite direction“朝相反方向”。

q48.explanationZh: “不同方向”不止一个，direction 用复数：in different directions。

q49.explanationZh: in all directions 或 in every direction 都表示“朝四面八方”；all 后用复数，every 后用单数。

q50.explanationZh: southerly“向南的”，easterly“向东的”，in a southerly/easterly direction“向南 / 朝东”。

q51.explanationZh: a sense of ...“……感”，a sense of direction“方向感”。

q52.explanationZh: directions 复数可表示“说明，指示”，follow directions“按照说明 / 指示”。

q53.explanationZh: “能给我指一下去邮局的路吗”，direct sb. to ...“给某人指路去……”，can 后用动词原形。

q54.explanationZh: “他把手指浸入水中”，dip“浸”，叙述过去的事用过去式 dipped，注意双写 p。

q55.explanationZh: “关于这个问题我的看法和你不同”，differ from“与……不同”，to 后用动词原形。

q56.explanationZh: “希望所有烦恼都会很快消失”，disappear“消失”，will 后用动词原形。

q57.explanationZh: “地面冻硬时很难挖”，it is difficult to do sth.“做某事很难”。

q58.explanationZh: in all directions“向四面八方”，all 后用复数 directions。

q59.explanationZh: “现在的全球化与 19 世纪末的有何不同”，differ from“与……不同”，does 后用动词原形。

q60.explanationZh: “公司因原料价格普遍上涨而遭受严重损失”，was 后用过去分词表被动：disadvantaged。

q61.explanationZh: get sth. + 形容词“使某物变得……”，get your clothes dirty“弄脏衣服”。

q62.explanationZh: “这种树很难移栽”，be difficult to do“难以做……”。

q63.sampleAnswer: The director successfully communicated the importance of protecting endangered species to the audience through this documentary.
references: The director successfully communicated the importance of protecting endangered species to the audience through this documentary.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q63.explanationZh: “导演”= director；“向观众传递……的重要性”= communicate the importance of ... to the audience；“通过这部纪录片”= through this documentary。

q64.sampleAnswer: There is a saying that nothing is difficult to the man who will try.
references: There is a saying that nothing is difficult to the man who will try.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q64.explanationZh: “有句谚语”= there is a saying that ...；“世上无难事，只要肯登攀”= nothing is difficult to the man who will try。

q65.sampleAnswer: A man’s dignity depends not upon his wealth or rank but upon his character.
references: A man’s dignity depends not upon his wealth or rank but upon his character.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q65.explanationZh: “人高尚与否”可译为 a man’s dignity；“不取决于……而取决于……”= depend not upon ... but upon ...。

q66.sampleAnswer: In addition to launching smart electronic products, the company is deepening cooperation with customers to explore the pathway to digital transformation and sustainable development.
references: In addition to launching smart electronic products, the company is deepening cooperation with customers to explore the pathway to digital transformation and sustainable development.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q66.explanationZh: “除了……外”= in addition to doing；“数字化转型”= digital transformation；“可持续发展”= sustainable development。

q67.sampleAnswer: She is a skilled diplomat and an expert negotiator.
references: She is a skilled diplomat and an expert negotiator.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q67.explanationZh: “老练的外交官”= a skilled diplomat；“专业的谈判代表”= an expert negotiator。

q68.sampleAnswer: The school authority and parents have different opinions on whether students must wear school uniforms.
references: The school authority and parents have different opinions on whether students must wear school uniforms.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q68.explanationZh: “各执一词”即“看法不同”= have different opinions on ...；“是否”= whether。

q69.sampleAnswer: The moment my aunt gained her diploma after four years of hard work, she was filled with joy.
references: The moment my aunt gained her diploma after four years of hard work, she was filled with joy.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q69.explanationZh: “……的那一刻”= the moment ...，引导时间状语；“获得文凭”= gain one’s diploma；“欣喜万分”= be filled with joy。

q70.sampleAnswer: He was disabled from birth, but he never felt frustrated, nor did he ever give in to any difficulty.
references: He was disabled from birth, but he never felt frustrated, nor did he ever give in to any difficulty.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q70.explanationZh: “生来就有残疾”= be disabled from birth；“也从未……”用 nor 开头要部分倒装：nor did he ...；“屈服于”= give in to。

q71.sampleAnswer: In many parts of the world, the phenomenon of valuing sons over daughters has put many women at a disadvantage in education and employment.
references: In many parts of the world, the phenomenon of valuing sons over daughters has put many women at a disadvantage in education and employment.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q71.explanationZh: “重男轻女”= value sons over daughters；“使……处于劣势”= put sb. at a disadvantage。

q72.sampleAnswer: These natural disasters have warned us that everyone should start to protect the environment immediately.
references: These natural disasters have warned us that everyone should start to protect the environment immediately.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q72.explanationZh: “自然灾害”= natural disasters；“警示我们……”= warn us that ...。
